name: Grünstein
beschreibung: Grünstein is a holiday home in Kaunerberg, Tirol. It is situated on a hill with a view of the Kaunertal. The accommodation has several bedrooms and bathrooms. There is a lounge with fireplace and a kitchen with modern appliances. A sauna complements the leisure offerings in the house. The nearby Kaunertaler Gletscher offers winter sports opportunities. In summer, hikes can be started directly from the house. The holiday home is suitable for up to ten people.
